desc: Leaving the boss rush from its battle (the Start menu doesn't open there): Start asks over the picture, Start again leaves; the battle ends as run away, the lent mid-game loadout goes back to the file's own pouch and Mario is back where the rush began in Rogueport

\[modes\] boss rush stopped at step 1: back to gor_01
